integrity: Complete self-contained proof and standard-library exact checker; finite checks are supplementary and not a proof of the infinite assertions. Status is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern Walsh Fourier analysis on the edge-coordinate Boolean group of connected simple cactus graphs. Known tree-block decomposition and binomial identities are inputs, not asserted new. The full historical-priority comparison is necessarily bounded; some relevant publicly indexed summaries were available without their complete text. No claims for overlapping-cycle graphs or general groups.
title: Sharp Walsh projection norms and cycle extremizers for cactus spanning trees
